rounds: The best person in a team should become its manager.
A manager should never shout at the team, even in a crisis.
People who work from home are harder to manage.
Most meetings could have been an email.
Managers should earn much more than the people they manage.
A good leader can lead any team, in any industry.
Charisma matters more than experience in a leader.
I would be happy for an algorithm to plan my working hours.
